Mossgrave Descent

Pick who you were before today. Then you get sixty seconds in your house to grab what you can carry before the floor opens up. Whatever you grab comes into the dungeon with you. You have three lives. When they're gone, the run is over.

Race selection

The Sponsor Machine

It hums. It smells faintly of popcorn. You have 0 gold.

Number keys to buy, E to leave. Controller: D-pad, A to buy, B to leave.

Map

M or View to close. You can keep moving with the map up.

White arrow: you. Red: a valve still to turn. Green: an open valve or a party member. Purple: a guild. Gold: chests, the weapon locker and open portals. Orange and blue rings: boss lairs.

Combat test

D-pad up and down to pick, left and right to change, A to use, B or Menu to resume.

Art style

Pick a style, then change any setting to mix your own. Controller: D-pad up and down to pick a row, left and right to change it, B to go back.

Inventory

Equipped

Gear

Jutsu

Weapons

Items and trinkets

Click a piece of gear to equip or take it off. One piece per slot; anything without a slot stays in your pack and is always on. Controller: D-pad to pick, A to equip, B to close. Weapon sets are in the Ledger.

The Stairwell

Skill Tree

Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, click a node twice to learn it. Controller: stick or D-pad to move, A twice to learn, LT and RT to zoom, B to close. Nothing can be refunded.

Ledger

Level up, check your skills, set up your two weapon sets and see your skills. Gear lives in your inventory (I, or X here on a controller). Skills improve by using them. Two-handed weapons, guns and bows take both hands. With a one-handed weapon you can hold a second one in your off hand, or leave it empty to block.

Skills

Quests

Controller: D-pad up and down to pick a slot, left and right or A to change it, X for the inventory, Y for the skill tree, B or View to close.
